name: smwgraphics-mega-man-bass-pirate-man-exterior
title: Mega Man & Bass - Pirate Man (Exterior)
description:
A hybrid beach / underwater background seen in the beginning of Pirate's Man level, from Mega Man & Bass, also known as, Rockman & Forte. It includes the bubble palette animation used in the game. Yes, it is a very neat trick to animate bubbles. A good fit for beachs with underwater exploration.

Credit would be nice, since this background was a headache to adjust, mainly to replicate the palette animation.
